notes.title: Update 1.0.2.2
notes.notes:
Changes:

 Only player can now move crates.
 Minor level edits
[/ list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.1
notes.notes:
Changes:

 Fixed bug when the box could be inside the player.
 Fixed a bug when a player sometimes teleported when colliding with a wall (hopefully)
 Minor changes in the initial levels
[/ list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Changes:

 Improved player interaction with the walls (sticking and repulsion)
 Some areas in the initial levels have become easier.
 Changed health upgrade sprite.
 Slightly reduced brightness in the menu.
[/ list]

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes: Greetings, dear players! Today was the release of Super Blasting Boy. I want to wish everyone a successful and enjoyable game! Be patient, iron nerves and prepare spare seats.
